meta.name: add-resend
meta.description: Add Resend (email) channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 在聊天应用中接入邮件发送渠道
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在应用里加邮件通知能力
copy.tagline_en: Add email sending to your chat app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add email notifications to your app

howto.what: 它把 Resend 邮件通道装进 NanoClaw:复制并注册适配器、安装固定版本依赖、构建验证,问你要 API key、发件地址等凭据写入 .env,再把你的邮箱登记为 owner 并发一封 hello 邮件。
howto.when: 当你想让 NanoClaw 通过邮件收发消息、给项目添加 Resend 邮件通道时使用;如果你正在跑 /setup,可以在流程中调用它。

say.text: 帮我接入 Resend 邮件通道,让机器人能收发邮件。
say.note: 会走复制适配器、装依赖、构建验证这几步。

say.text: 收不到 hello 邮件,帮我查域名验证和 webhook 配置。
say.note: 对应排障一节:域名、webhook、密钥。

howto.what_en: It installs the Resend email channel into NanoClaw: copies and registers the adapter, installs a pinned dependency, builds and tests, asks for your API key and from-address into .env, then wires your address as owner and sends a hello email.
howto.when_en: Use when you want NanoClaw to hold email conversations through Resend — during /setup or whenever you add the email channel.

say_en.text: Add the Resend email channel so the bot can send and receive email.
say_en.note: Runs copy, dependency install and build steps.

say_en.text: My email is me@example.com — have the default agent answer it.
say_en.note: Registers you as owner and sends a hello email.

say_en.text: The hello email never arrived; check my domain and webhook.
